text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 20, "unit": "times", "kind": "count", "span": "The first friend pressed on the doorbell 20 times"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 1, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "1/4 times more than Jerome's first friend (numerator)"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 4, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "1/4 times more than Jerome's first friend (denominator)"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 10, "unit": "times", "kind": "count", "span": "10 times more than the fourth friend"}, {"id": "q5", "value": 60, "unit": "times", "kind": "count", "span": "the fourth friend pressed on the doorbell 60 times"}], "plan": [{"op": "mul", "args": ["q1", "q2"], "out": "s1", "note": "numerator of a quarter of the first friend's presses"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["s1", "q3"], "out": "s2", "note": "a quarter of the first friend's presses"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q1", "s2"], "out": "s3", "note": "the second friend's presses"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q5", "q4"], "out": "s4", "note": "the third friend = ten more than the fourth"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q1", "s3"], "out": "s5", "note": "first plus second friend"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s5", "s4"], "out": "s6", "note": "plus the third friend"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s6", "q5"], "out": "s7", "note": "plus the fourth friend"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "the total number of doorbell rings from all four friends"}, "dismissed": [{"value": 0.3333333333333333, "reason": "the word 'third' in 'the third friend' is an ordinal label for a person, not a fraction or a quantity"}]}
